{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
df["sample_seq"] = pd.to_numeric(df["sample_seq"], errors='coerce')

df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Stratify by severity
strata = df_dedup["severity"].unique()

# Initialize list to store stratum-specific risk differences
stratum_diffs = []

# Compute response rate in each arm within each severity stratum
for severity in strata:
    df_sev = df_dedup[df_dedup["severity"] == severity]
    
    # Compute response rates
    resp_treat = df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "treatment"]["responded"].mean()
    resp_control = df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "control"]["responded"].mean()
    
    # Compute risk difference
    diff = resp_treat - resp_control
    
    # Store
    stratum_diffs.append({
        "severity": severity,
        "n_treatment": len(df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "treatment"])
        ,
        "n_control": len(df_sev[df_sev["arm"] == "control"])
        ,
        "resp_treat": resp_treat,
        "resp_control": resp_control,
        "diff": diff
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
stratum_df = pd.DataFrame(stratum_diffs)

# Compute overall risk difference using weighted average (by stratum size)
# Weight by total number of patients in each stratum
stratum_total = df_dedup.groupby("severity").size()
stratum_weights = stratum_total / stratum_total.sum()

# Weighted average of risk differences
weighted_diff = (stratum_df["diff"] * stratum_weights).sum()

# Print detailed results with full precision
print("Stratum-level results:")
print(stratum_df)
print(f"\nStratum sizes: {stratum_total.to_dict()}")
print(f"Stratum weights: {stratum_weights.to_dict()}")
print(f"Weighted average risk difference: {weighted_diff:.10f}")"}
